# Book_03 — A Proposed Governance Substrate
:::


::: {.callout-note}
Introduces OrgTree (the governed registry of organizational structure) and OrgPath (the coordinate stamped on every user, device, and server) as the proposed substrate that closes the governance gap left by the decomposition of Active Directory into the Microsoft cloud stack. Companion to the [Old AD vs New EntraID foundational reference](../learning/old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.qmd).
:::
